restrictions: Two distinct 64-byte messages M(x), M(y). W0..W7 are the fixed prefix in proof Section 1; W8=y0, W9=y1; W10..W15 add the fixed offsets dbce7a42, aaf3823d, 8d41a28c, 7f214e02, 6423f959, 7e640e8c. The target uses the standard IV, exactly 41 steps on both padded blocks, feed-forward, and all 256 output bits.

The walk is g(x)=walkB(state_41(M(x))) XOR q with published q=0cfb8236e26291fd9201bdd8fe26ebf7e10110d6efda32e9d9245941c1a02881. The output registers already hold g. A collision of g implies equal complete digests.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, reference_operation_cost=2980. The machine has 1024 registers. Body records cost five code bytes and one operation; other instructions cost 36 bytes.
Preprocessing is 462181911947910039 operations and includes the wasm emitter plus the complete 1641-candidate offset and selector search envelopes. preprocessing_log2 rounds upward to 47.14015.
Peak memory is 1048574 bytes; setup peaks at 605579 bytes. Every table and code field fits its declared width.

The normative embedded C source has SHA-256 89d30bb391e9687895d6cb7ae08e0d51fc1faf64ca7b8de3ec891df8d2061a63; stripped wasm SHA-256 ed3771d798ab2d2ac90a2a7195948c30bd965cbcf8e833e3756ca0c7c99c999a; emitted SLP SHA-256 61159520df7c39782aa9280c39c88da645375d37da483d939820634b704580da. The organizer executes the packaged Python byte-exact mirror; wasm accounting is participant-run.
For a uniformly random function, the bounded-restart calculation in proof Section 2 gives P_F at least 0.390000001000. H1 is the only score-critical premise and is declared, not proved.
Credited derivative of e08e7b6a-9313-4ace-b683-ff02006321f9, d22ae1b2-2368-460a-b6d4-1e5e37ceb735, 95263e47-d61b-43a6-bb46-30ced2488280, and their same-challenge lineage.

heuristics.statement: The fixed walk succeeds at least as often as the exact bounded attempt against a lazy-sampled uniformly random 256-bit function. Fresh outputs retain collision hazard 2^-256, the first-collision law of a random mapping, independent DP density, and the same hazard after conditioning on the adaptive history.
heuristics.scope: The sha256-r41-prefix-v1 target, the 64-byte message family in proof Section 1, about 2^128 evaluations, and 256 simultaneous trails.
heuristics.extrapolation: The experiments check program correctness at width 16 and full-width projections. Extrapolation to the full attempt is by H1 only.
heuristics.limitations: H1 is a model premise about one fixed function, not a theorem. The experiments do not observe full-width collisions or estimate the claimed probability.
